name: m3dcodie-eng-flow
description: eng-flow — a tool-agnostic engineering process, as installable Claude Code skills: a lightweight MVP mode for fast, low-ceremony builds, and a staged production-grade track (spec through ship) for work that needs formal requirements, architecture, review, and QA. PROCESS.md defines the routing between the two.

plugins.name: eng-flow
plugins.description: Skills implementing the production-grade track of the eng-flow process (PROCESS.md): spec, domain model, architecture, eng review, UI design, epics/stories/tasks, implementation, code review, QA, ship, retro, analytics. Lightweight MVP-mode work (one-pager spec, flat task list, no formal stages) is handled inline by the spec skill — there's no separate MVP skill set.
